items.a: Anyone preparing for the lorry (LGV) theory test in Great Britain: categories C1, C, C1+E and C+E. It focuses on the multiple-choice part of the Driver CPC part 1 theory test.

This is version {version}. Each map is checked against official GOV.UK guidance, The Highway Code or the law, and the date of the check is printed on every page ({checkedOn}). When the rules change, we update the PDFs and you get the new version free.
No. It's an independent revision guide based on official public guidance and the law. All the practice questions are our own, not taken from the official question bank.

items.q: Does it cover buses and coaches?
items.a: No. It's made for lorry drivers. Some rules are shared, but the drivers' hours, loads and vehicle checks are the goods vehicle versions.

items.q: Does it cover the Driver CPC case studies (part 2)?
items.a: The maps cover the knowledge the case studies draw on, like drivers' hours, loads, security and incidents, but they are not case-study practice.
Right after you pay, Hotmart emails you your access to the members area, where you download the PDFs.
Yes. Every map is an A4 page, made to print at home.

items.q: Does it work on my phone or tablet?
items.a: Yes, the PDFs open on any device. They're designed for A4, so they're most comfortable on a tablet or printed; on a phone, zoom in. The flashcards also come in a phone version.
No. They're high-resolution PDFs for your personal use.
Yes. You have {guaranteeDays} days from your purchase to ask for a full refund through Hotmart, no questions asked.
